# Setup

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
  source("./Parameters.R")
  library(mgcv)
  library(broom)

  # configurable parameters
  MAX_LAG <- 5 # maximum number of days to look back for exposures
  MIN_POP <- 1 # minimum number of potentially exposed persons (population in a single commune, by year, climat, densite, sex, and age group)
  print(sprintf("MAX_LAG = %s [days], MIN_POP = %d [persons per commune]", MAX_LAG, MIN_POP))

  # configurable inner knots for cubic regression splines, k = length(knots)
  knots_tmpc <- function(vec, step) {
    knots <- c(-10, -5, 0, 5, seq(10, 50, step))
    knots <- c(min(vec), knots[which(knots >= min(vec) + 0.5 * step & knots <= max(vec) - 0.5 * step)], max(vec))
    return(knots)
  }
  knots_hump <- function(vec, n) {
    return(seq(min(vec), max(vec), length.out = n))
  }
```

```{r Load}
  # load preprocessed outcomes, geography, population, and exposures

```
# Regression Models

```{r Model}
  # safe utility to extract and lag exposures
  safe_lag <- function(days, df, max_lag, basename) {
    for (lag in 0:max(max_lag, 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      tmp <- left_join(days %>% mutate(dl = date - lag), df, join_by("dl" == "date")) %>% select(-dl) %>% pivot_longer(!date, names_to = "code")
      if (lag == 0) {
        ret <- tmp %>% rename_with(~ifelse(.x %in% c("code", "date"), .x, paste(basename, lag, sep = "_lag_")))
      } else {
        if (sum((ret$code != tmp$code) | (ret$date != tmp$date)) != 0) { stop("THIS SHOULD NEVER HAPPEN!") }
        ret <- cbind(ret, tmp %>% select(-code, -date) %>% rename_with(~paste(basename, lag, sep = "_lag_")))
      }
    }
    return(ret)
  }

  # stratify temporally using five periods of seven years each
  for (p in unique(YEARS_PERIODS$period)) {
    # analyze outcomes for all summer days for all years within period, extending to full weeks
    years_in_period <- YEARS_PERIODS %>% filter(period == p) %>% pull("year")
    days_analyze <- foreach(y = years_in_period, .combine = rbind, .packages = "tidyverse") %dopar% {
      first_summer_day <- floor_date(as.Date(sprintf(SUMMER_START, y)), "week")     # Monday
      last_summer_day  <- floor_date(as.Date(sprintf(SUMMER_END,   y)), "week") + 6 # Sunday
      data.frame(date = seq(first_summer_day, last_summer_day, by = "day")) }

    # stratify geographically by climat and densite
    for (c in levels(geo_info$climat)) {
      for (d in levels(geo_info$densite)) {
        # compute matrix of lagged exposures (identical for both sexes and all age groups), for communes in climat/densite
        communes <- geo_info %>% filter(climat == c, densite == d) %>% pull(code)
        tmpc <- safe_lag(days_analyze, tmpc_info %>% select(date, all_of(communes)), MAX_LAG, "tmpc")
        hump <- safe_lag(days_analyze, hump_info %>% select(date, all_of(communes)), MAX_LAG, "hump")

        # stratify demographically by sex and age group
        for (s in unique(pop_info$sex)) {
          for (a in levels(pop_info$age)) {
            # compile relevant inputs for regressions: outcomes, exposures, exposed population, secular/seasonal info, ignore communes with <1 exposed person(s)
            df <- expand.grid(date = days_analyze$date, code = communes) %>%
              mutate(year = year(date), yday = yday(date), wday = wday(date), monday = floor_date(date, "week")) %>%
              left_join(., deaths   %>% filter(sex == s, age == a) %>% select(-sex, -age), by = c("code", "date")) %>% mutate(n = ifelse(is.na(n), 0, n)) %>%
              left_join(., pop_info %>% filter(sex == s, age == a) %>% select(-sex, -age), by = c("code", "year")) %>% filter(!is.na(pop), pop >= MIN_POP) %>%
              left_join(., tmpc,                                                           by = c("code", "date")) %>%
              left_join(., hump,                                                           by = c("code", "date")) %>%
              mutate(tmpc_lag_a = 0.25 * (tmpc_lag_0 + tmpc_lag_1 + tmpc_lag_2 + tmpc_lag_3)) %>% # compute average lagged exposure over prior 0:3 days
              mutate(hump_lag_a = 0.25 * (hump_lag_0 + hump_lag_1 + hump_lag_2 + hump_lag_3)) %>% # compute average lagged exposure over prior 0:3 days
              mutate(rate = n / pop, year = year - min(years_in_period)) %>% select(-date)
            if (nrow(df) == 0 || sum(is.na(df)) != 0) { stop("Lookup failed for outcome and/or exposure and/or exposed population (daily models)") }

            # aggregate deaths over the 7 days of each week to compute the weekly mean rate, move lagged averaged temperature and humidity exposures to 7 columns
            dw <- df %>% group_by(code, year, monday) %>% mutate(rate = sum(n) / sum(pop), pop = mean(pop)) %>% ungroup() %>% arrange(code, year, monday, wday)
            dw <- list(year       = dw %>% filter(wday == 1) %>% pull("year"),
                       rate       = dw %>% filter(wday == 1) %>% pull("rate"),
                       pop        = dw %>% filter(wday == 1) %>% pull("pop"),
                       yday       = data.matrix(dw %>% select(code, year, monday, wday, yday)       %>% pivot_wider(names_from = wday, names_prefix = "yday", values_from = yday)       %>% select(starts_with("yday"))),
                       tmpc_lag_a = data.matrix(dw %>% select(code, year, monday, wday, tmpc_lag_a) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = wday, names_prefix = "tmpc", values_from = tmpc_lag_a) %>% select(starts_with("tmpc"))), 
                       hump_lag_a = data.matrix(dw %>% select(code, year, monday, wday, hump_lag_a) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = wday, names_prefix = "hump", values_from = hump_lag_a) %>% select(starts_with("hump"))))

            # prepare to evaluate weekly/daily model on daily/daily data, leveraging the implicit summation, i.e., using 7 days with identical exposures for correct balance between parametric and smooth terms!
            dp <- list(year       = df$year,
                       rate       = df$rate,
                       pop        = df$pop,
                       yday       = data.matrix(data.frame(y1 = df$yday,       y2 = df$yday,       y3 = df$yday,       y4 = df$yday,       y5 = df$yday,       y6 = df$yday,       y7 = df$yday)), 
                       tmpc_lag_a = data.matrix(data.frame(t1 = df$tmpc_lag_a, t2 = df$tmpc_lag_a, t3 = df$tmpc_lag_a, t4 = df$tmpc_lag_a, t5 = df$tmpc_lag_a, t6 = df$tmpc_lag_a, t7 = df$tmpc_lag_a)), 
                       hump_lag_a = data.matrix(data.frame(h1 = df$hump_lag_a, h2 = df$hump_lag_a, h3 = df$hump_lag_a, h4 = df$hump_lag_a, h5 = df$hump_lag_a, h6 = df$hump_lag_a, h7 = df$hump_lag_a)))
            if (sum(is.na(dw$year)) + sum(is.na(dw$rate)) + sum(is.na(dw$pop)) + sum(is.na(dw$yday)) != 0) { stop("Lookup failed for covariates (week/day models)") }
            if (sum(is.na(dp$year)) + sum(is.na(dp$rate)) + sum(is.na(dp$pop)) + sum(is.na(dp$yday)) != 0) { stop("Lookup failed for covariates (week/day prediction)") }
            if (sum(is.na(dw$tmpc_lag_a)) + sum(is.na(dw$hump_lag_a)) != 0) { stop("Pivot(s) failed for exposures (week/day models)") }
            if (sum(is.na(dp$tmpc_lag_a)) + sum(is.na(dp$hump_lag_a)) != 0) { stop("Pivot(s) failed for exposures (week/day prediction)") }

            # equidistant knots for temperature exposure (above 10°C): step size 4°C, decreased down to 1°C in case of convergence problems
            for (delta_tmpc in c(4, 3, 2, 1)) {
              # define list of fixed knots by region of interest, adjusting spacing for temperature if necessary, 4 equidistant points for humidity
              k <- list(tmpc_lag_0 = knots_tmpc(df$tmpc_lag_0, delta_tmpc), hump_lag_0 = knots_hump(df$hump_lag_0, 4),
                        tmpc_lag_1 = knots_tmpc(df$tmpc_lag_1, delta_tmpc), hump_lag_1 = knots_hump(df$hump_lag_1, 4),
                        tmpc_lag_2 = knots_tmpc(df$tmpc_lag_2, delta_tmpc), hump_lag_2 = knots_hump(df$hump_lag_2, 4),
                        tmpc_lag_3 = knots_tmpc(df$tmpc_lag_3, delta_tmpc), hump_lag_3 = knots_hump(df$hump_lag_3, 4),
                        tmpc_lag_4 = knots_tmpc(df$tmpc_lag_4, delta_tmpc), hump_lag_4 = knots_hump(df$hump_lag_4, 4),
                        tmpc_lag_5 = knots_tmpc(df$tmpc_lag_5, delta_tmpc), hump_lag_5 = knots_hump(df$hump_lag_5, 4),
                        tmpc_lag_a = knots_tmpc(df$tmpc_lag_a, delta_tmpc), hump_lag_a = knots_hump(df$hump_lag_a, 4))

              # DLNM_PO full DLNM without smoothness constraints along the lag dimension, potentially overfitting, multiplicative (poisson, log link)
              # DE03_PO simple model with daily outcome and lagged exposure (averaged over prior 0:3 days), multiplicative (poisson, log link)
              # DE03_GA simple model with daily outcome and lagged exposure (averaged over prior 0:3 days), additive (gaussian, identity link)
              # WE03_GA simple model with weekly outcome and lagged exposure (averaged over prior 0:3 days), additive (gaussian, identity link), implicit summation
              DLNM_PO <- bam(n ~ offset(log(pop)) + year + ti(yday, bs = "cr", k = 3) + te(tmpc_lag_0, hump_lag_0, bs = "cr", k = c(length(k[["tmpc_lag_0"]]), length(k[["hump_lag_0"]]))) +
                                                                                        te(tmpc_lag_1, hump_lag_1, bs = "cr", k = c(length(k[["tmpc_lag_1"]]), length(k[["hump_lag_1"]]))) +
                                                                                        te(tmpc_lag_2, hump_lag_2, bs = "cr", k = c(length(k[["tmpc_lag_2"]]), length(k[["hump_lag_2"]]))) +
                                                                                        te(tmpc_lag_3, hump_lag_3, bs = "cr", k = c(length(k[["tmpc_lag_3"]]), length(k[["hump_lag_3"]]))) +
                                                                                        te(tmpc_lag_4, hump_lag_4, bs = "cr", k = c(length(k[["tmpc_lag_4"]]), length(k[["hump_lag_4"]]))) +
                                                                                        te(tmpc_lag_5, hump_lag_5, bs = "cr", k = c(length(k[["tmpc_lag_5"]]), length(k[["hump_lag_5"]]))),
                             data = df, discrete = TRUE, nthreads = get_num_cores(), knots = k, family = poisson(link = "log"))
              DE03_PO <- bam(n ~ offset(log(pop)) + year + ti(yday, bs = "cr", k = 3) + te(tmpc_lag_a, hump_lag_a, bs = "cr", k = c(length(k[["tmpc_lag_a"]]), length(k[["hump_lag_a"]]))),
                             data = df, discrete = TRUE, nthreads = get_num_cores(), knots = k, family = poisson(link = "log"))
              DE03_GA <- bam(rate ~ 1             + year + ti(yday, bs = "cr", k = 3) + te(tmpc_lag_a, hump_lag_a, bs = "cr", k = c(length(k[["tmpc_lag_a"]]), length(k[["hump_lag_a"]]))),
                             data = df, discrete = TRUE, nthreads = get_num_cores(), knots = k, family = gaussian(link = "identity"), weights = pop)
              WE03_GA <- bam(rate ~ 1             + year + ti(yday, bs = "cr", k = 3) + te(tmpc_lag_a, hump_lag_a, bs = "cr", k = c(length(k[["tmpc_lag_a"]]), length(k[["hump_lag_a"]]))),
                             data = dw, discrete = TRUE, nthreads = get_num_cores(), knots = k, family = gaussian(link = "identity"), weights = pop)

              # check for convergence, report if finer grid of knots was required
              if (DLNM_PO$conv && DLNM_PO$mgcv.conv && DE03_PO$conv && DE03_PO$mgcv.conv && DE03_GA$conv && DE03_GA$mgcv.conv && WE03_GA$conv && WE03_GA$mgcv.conv) {
                if (delta_tmpc != 4) { print(sprintf("ALL CONVERGED at delta_tmpc = %s (%s %s %s %s %s)", delta_tmpc, p, c, d, s, a)) }
                break
              }
            }

            # report any convergence failures
            if (!DLNM_PO$conv || !DLNM_PO$mgcv.conv) { print(sprintf("DLNM_PO: CONVERGENCE FAILED (%s %s %s %s %s)", p, c, d, s, a)) }
            if (!DE03_PO$conv || !DE03_PO$mgcv.conv) { print(sprintf("DE03_PO: CONVERGENCE FAILED (%s %s %s %s %s)", p, c, d, s, a)) }
            if (!DE03_GA$conv || !DE03_GA$mgcv.conv) { print(sprintf("DE03_GA: CONVERGENCE FAILED (%s %s %s %s %s)", p, c, d, s, a)) }
            if (!WE03_GA$conv || !WE03_GA$mgcv.conv) { print(sprintf("WE03_GA: CONVERGENCE FAILED (%s %s %s %s %s)", p, c, d, s, a)) }

            # evaluate fits to observed data, on a daily basis, extract meta-information from regressions
            fits <- df %>% select(year, yday, tmpc_lag_0, n, pop) %>% mutate(DLNM_PO =       predict(DLNM_PO, type = "response"),
                                                                             DE03_PO =       predict(DE03_PO, type = "response"),
                                                                             DE03_GA = pop * predict(DE03_GA, type = "response"),
                                                                             WE03_GA = pop * predict(WE03_GA, type = "response", newdata = dp))
            days_total <- fits %>% group_by(year, yday)       %>% reframe(across(c(n, pop, DLNM_PO, DE03_PO, DE03_GA, WE03_GA), ~sum(.x))) %>% mutate(year = year + min(years_in_period))
            tmpc_total <- fits %>% group_by(year, tmpc_lag_0) %>% reframe(across(c(n, pop, DLNM_PO, DE03_PO, DE03_GA, WE03_GA), ~sum(.x))) %>% mutate(year = year + min(years_in_period))
            parametric <- rbind(tidy(DLNM_PO, parametric = TRUE)  %>% mutate(model = "DLNM_PO"),
                                tidy(DE03_PO, parametric = TRUE)  %>% mutate(model = "DE03_PO"),
                                tidy(DE03_GA, parametric = TRUE)  %>% mutate(model = "DE03_GA"),
                                tidy(WE03_GA, parametric = TRUE)  %>% mutate(model = "WE03_GA"))
            te_smooths <- rbind(tidy(DLNM_PO, parametric = FALSE) %>% mutate(model = "DLNM_PO"),
                                tidy(DE03_PO, parametric = FALSE) %>% mutate(model = "DE03_PO"),
                                tidy(DE03_GA, parametric = FALSE) %>% mutate(model = "DE03_GA"),
                                tidy(WE03_GA, parametric = FALSE) %>% mutate(model = "WE03_GA"))
            
            # save results for later analysis
            save(p, c, d, s, a, days_total, tmpc_total, parametric, te_smooths, file = sprintf("../Processed/Processed_%s_%s_%s_%s_%s.Rdata", p, c, d, s, a))
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
```
